finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: Attacker inputs a command with shell metacharacters (e.g., `; rm -rf /`) followed by a newline
finding.assumptions: The code does not sanitize or validate input before using it in a command execution context. The attacker could potentially inject shell commands into the input.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: Attacker inputs more than 257 characters (the size of buffer - 1 for null terminator)
finding.assumptions: The buffer is fixed-size and does not dynamically adjust based on input size. The attacker could potentially overflow the buffer.
